notes: HR reference data for Kenyan companies (docs/modules/hr.md HR-03, HR-12, HR-13): identifier types and statutory leave types. Each row has a status (ResearchStatus): 'researched' values come from public research (docs/country-packs-research-2026-10.md) with their confidence, research date and sources; they are used, and leave records that use them say so until the owner confirms them through a pack release (ADM-04). A null pattern enforces no format (patterns are checked on the value upper-cased without spaces, dashes, dots or slashes; a format check only, no checksum). A null days value makes the leave type 'Days needed' (requests and accrual refused) until a tenant confirms it. qualifying_months: months of service before the type can be taken; half_pay_days: days at half pay after the full-pay days, in the same year; events: per-event days within the type's yearly days. Labels live in lang/{locale}/hr.php (pack.*).
